Hi all — preliminary SRE findings attached. TL;DR: we observed a short-lived spike in 503 responses originating from the routing layer for the Checkoutly tenant between 09:02:14 and 09:17:58 PDT. The spike correlates with a sudden increase in concurrent requests; autoscaler decisions combined with a brief control-plane delay led to underprovisioning on a small subset of worker shards.

Key timestamps (PDT):
- 09:01:58 — sustained traffic rise begins
- 09:02:14 — 503 rate increases (sampled per shard)
- 09:05:30 — partial autoscale triggered, warmup started
- 09:08:50 — first worker pool ready (partial recovery)
- 09:17:58 — 503 rate returns to baseline

Impact summary: 14–18 failed checkout attempts observed in our traces for the tenant (matching your 15). Attached: availability-traces-20260711.zip (raw traces, request ids), and a short aq-log-snippet.txt showing the control-plane scale events.

Next steps proposed:
1) I can provide a signed trace bundle and a concise incident window for SLA adjudication (we'll follow the contract measurement method) — target: within 24 hours.
2) If the incident meets the SLA definition, we'll calculate the pro-rated credit per your plan's terms and return a proposed adjustment to billing.
3) We'll produce a targeted postmortem (72-hour draft) that includes root cause, corrective actions, and immediate mitigations (improved autoscale hysteresis + pre-warm policy for promo traffic).

Marissa / Steph: please confirm whether Checkoutly wants the expedited credit calculation (we can fast-track billing adjustment while the postmortem is written).

— David Kim
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — thanks for confirming. Finalizing next steps here so we have a clear path: 

1) Incident window for reconciliation (UTC): 2026-07-11T16:02:14Z — 2026-07-11T16:17:58Z (this corresponds to PDT window we observed). We'll include signed trace bundle when we hand off evidence.

2) Credit calculation: per section 4.2 of your MSA (Availability), we measure tenant availability using the platform request success rate for the affected region and apply the pro-rata monthly credit. I'll attach a one-line calculation in the billing ticket, but provisional approach: given observed impact (~16 failures over ~15 minutes) and your subscribed SLA tier (99.9%), estimated pro-rata credit is modest — we will provide exact dollar amount in 24 hours once the raw traces are validated. If you want an immediate provisional credit to unblock finance, reply 'provisional' and we'll issue a one-off write-down pending final calc.

3) Postmortem ETA: draft within 72 hours (target: Tue, 2026-07-14 09:00 PDT). Final postmortem after internal review + your feedback within 7 days. The postmortem will include root cause, timeline, and mitigation action items (autoscale hysteresis adjustments, pre-warm config options for scheduled promos, and an ops-runbook update).

4) Attachments & evidence: availability-traces-20260711.zip and aq-log-snippet.txt attached to this thread. HubSpot deal/incident: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/10345/CHK-4921. Raw trace folder (read-only, expires in 30 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-checkoutly-raw-traces.

If you confirm 'provisional' we will instruct billing to apply a temporary adjustment while we finalize the exact credit. Otherwise we'll return the precise calculation within 24 hours.

Apologies again for the disruption. We'll follow up with the signed trace bundle shortly.
